A stale variable from an earlier cycle inserted validator source code into the design document; caught by a membership check, repaired from the committed blob, and recorded as a working-state hazard.

Report budget completion per condition with completed counts, denominators and Wilson intervals, state that four episodes per condition cannot establish a difference, and keep the outcome separate from the quality endpoint.
nodes.question: How should the budget completion rates be reported given four episodes per condition?
alternatives: report the rates alone
omit them until a larger block exists
report them with denominators and intervals and state what four episodes cannot show
nodes.falsifier: If a larger block shows overlapping completion rates across conditions, the asymmetry here was noise and the emphasis was misplaced.

nodes.description: Record the requirement as committed code that reads its cost from an executed receipt rather than from an assumption, do not spend six times the prior total without approval, and ask the question with a default of not spending while the loop continues.
nodes.question: Should the block be extended now, or should the requirement be recorded first?
alternatives: run a third repeat because it is cheap
run the full 116-episode block
compute the requirement from measured cost and put the spend to the user with a default of not spending
nodes.falsifier: If a much smaller extension would reach the target precision, the requirement is overstated and the recommendation is wrong.

nodes.description: Precision-based block planning: 29 episodes per condition, 116 in total, about 18 dollars at a cost per episode read from an executed receipt. The extension was not run and the spend was put to the user with a default of not spending.
Report that the quality endpoint cannot be sized today, name both blockers with their kinds, and record that the calibration labels are the single binding constraint on the quality arm.
nodes.question: Can the quality endpoint be sized, and if not, what should be reported instead?
alternatives: size it using the provisional variance
assume a plausible variance
report that it cannot be sized and name what blocks it
nodes.falsifier: If the quality endpoint can be sized from admissible data without human labels, the blocker is misidentified.

nodes.description: Per-outcome planning status: completion is planable at 116 episodes; quality is blocked by zero of twenty-five human labels and by an unbalanced admissible design. The labels are the single binding constraint on the quality arm.
Freeze a preregistration for the completion arm before any episode beyond the current sixteen exists, seal it by its own digest, and gate it so the document cannot change once the block grows.
nodes.question: Should the completion arm be pre-registered now, and what should the document fix?
alternatives: analyse the completion arm when the data arrive
write a loose plan
freeze a full preregistration and gate it so it cannot change once the block grows
nodes.falsifier: if the document can be edited after the block grows without the gate firing, the seal is decorative.

nodes.description: A frozen preregistration for the completion arm, sealed by its own digest before any episode beyond the current sixteen exists, gated so it cannot change once the block grows. Three failing-first mutations fire.
Keep the reliability figures undowngraded, and state in the manuscript that they characterise the judge rather than the episodes, naming the admission refusal they fall under.
nodes.question: Do the judge reliability figures fall under the same downgrade as the variance components?
alternatives: downgrade them too, since they use the same episodes
leave the distinction implicit
state the distinction explicitly and keep them undowngraded
nodes.falsifier: If a reliability figure is used anywhere as an episode score or as evidence about a condition, the distinction is being abused and the figure must be downgraded.

nodes.description: Audit of every manuscript number derived from the unscorable blocks: all but two already carried the dependency label, and the two are instrument characterisation rather than episode scores, now stated explicitly.

Report the replication with unparsed verdicts counted as disagreements, state both the raw and the excluding figures, and treat the replicated stratification as support for the confidence floor rather than for the judge in general.
nodes.question: Does the reliability measured on the variance block transfer to the new tasks?
alternatives: assume it transfers
re-measure only the high band
judge every element on the new artifacts with both judges and report the stratification
nodes.falsifier: If a later block shows disagreement among high-confidence pairs, the floor does not hold and the abstention rule must be raised or abandoned.

nodes.description: Reliability re-measured on unseen confirmation tasks with two judges from different provider families: the stratification replicated exactly, 12/12 above 0.9, 14/18 in the middle, 0/9 below 0.7.

Record the high-recall assumption as falsified, treat a no-span result as an unresolved item rather than a negative verdict, and require the retrieval step to have measured recall before the endpoint is used for scoring.
nodes.question: Is the candidate filter high-recall, as the endpoint design assumes?
alternatives: assume the filter rarely misses
check only items where a span was retrieved
re-judge every no-span item on the full artifact
nodes.falsifier: If a measured recall check shows the filter misses rarely on a larger sample, the assumption stands and this result was specific to nine items.

nodes.description: Nine items scored negative without any model call were re-judged on the full artifact: both judges call four satisfied and one more is called satisfied by one judge, falsifying the high-recall assumption the endpoint rests on.

Report the complete negative-overturn rate with its split, state that the endpoint understates coverage in one direction at roughly that rate, and bound the whole measurement by noting that the reference is two-judge agreement on the full artifact rather than ground truth.
nodes.question: Does the retrieval failure extend to items where a span was returned?
alternatives: assume a returned span is adequate
check only a sample
re-judge every span-negative item on the full artifact
nodes.falsifier: If human labels later agree with the pipeline verdicts on these items, the wider view was wrong and the overturn rate does not indicate bias.

nodes.description: Judge the whole artifact as the primary path, retain the span-based verdict on a twenty percent subsample as a drift check, and do not repair cue retrieval.
nodes.question: Should the endpoint repair its retrieval or remove it?
alternatives: widen the cues and re-measure
keep retrieval and accept the miss rate
judge the whole artifact and keep the cheaper verdict on a subsample
nodes.falsifier: If the subsample shows the two paths agreeing closely, the retrieval stage was not the problem and the extra cost is unjustified.

nodes.description: Whole-artifact judging adopted over cue retrieval at a measured 1.61 times cost per judgement, with the span verdict retained on a twenty percent subsample as a drift check; the trade of a measured failure mode for an unmeasured one is stated.

Report the aggregate instrument shift and its ratio to the detectable effect, do not report per-condition coverage under the new method, and restate that these verdicts remain inadmissible for scoring.
nodes.question: What does the endpoint read once retrieval is removed, and how should it be reported?
alternatives: report per-condition coverage under the new method
report nothing until calibration
report the aggregate instrument shift and compare it with the detectable effect
nodes.falsifier: If a calibrated endpoint shows the two methods reading within the detectable effect of each other, the method choice does not dominate and this comparison is overstated.

nodes.description: Re-scoring under whole-artifact judging shifts mean coverage from 0.542 to 0.729, about 2.3 times the paired detectable effect, with four verdicts moving toward negative; per-condition means are deliberately not reported.

Void the paired minimum detectable effect as a design target, record that it omitted a variance component larger than the one it used, and require sample-size planning to treat the scoring method as a facet with its own variance rather than as a settled choice.
nodes.question: Can the paired detectable effect still size a block once the instrument varies?
alternatives: keep the number and note the caveat
adjust it by the mean method shift
void it as a design target and require the instrument to enter the variance model
nodes.falsifier: If a larger sample shows the method difference small and consistent, the instrument is close to fixed and the earlier detectable effect stands.

nodes.description: The instrument facet varies more than the effect: method-difference sd 0.301 against a detectable effect of 0.0825, variance 1.48 times the coverage variance, and the difference changes sign. The paired detectable effect is void as a design target.

Stop sizing the quality arm. Report that the endpoint as constructed does not separate the conditions it was built to compare, that adding episodes cannot repair this, and that either the endpoint changes or no condition claim is available from it.
nodes.question: With the scoring method as a facet, can the quality arm be sized at all?
alternatives: size a larger block on the new variance model
pool the two tasks to gain degrees of freedom
report that the endpoint does not separate conditions and stop sizing it
nodes.falsifier: If an endpoint with the same conditions and more artifacts shows a condition component that is a material share of variance, the endpoint separates conditions and this conclusion was an artefact of eight artifacts.

nodes.description: A crossed condition by method by element study per task puts 0.9 percent and a clamped zero of the endpoint variance on the condition, with dependability 0.040 and 0.000 and no reachable element count for 0.8. Sizing the quality arm is abandoned.

Report the contrast, treat the process figures as a manipulation check, and state that the design cannot distinguish an inert manipulation from an insensitive endpoint, while noting that the falsified retrieval filter and the near-zero condition component both point at the endpoint.
nodes.question: Is the endpoint insensitive, or are the conditions inert?
alternatives: treat the null as evidence the conditions do not matter
switch the primary endpoint to a process quantity
report the contrast and name the ambiguity as unresolved by this design
nodes.falsifier: If a repaired endpoint on the same artifacts shows a material condition component, the endpoint was insensitive and the null reading was wrong.

nodes.description: Process quantities separate the conditions at 0.899 and 0.951 while judged coverage separates them not at all; the process figures are a manipulation check, and the design cannot distinguish an inert manipulation from an insensitive endpoint.

Report that repair did not produce a condition component, state that this favours the reading in which these conditions do not change judged artifact quality, and refuse to call it a null result given three to four conditions and two repeats.
nodes.question: Does repairing the endpoint reveal the condition effect it was suspected of hiding?
alternatives: declare a null effect of the conditions
keep both readings open indefinitely
report that repair did not produce the component and say which reading that favours
nodes.falsifier: If a calibrated endpoint with human-anchored labels shows a material condition component on these same artifacts, the repair was still incomplete and this reading was wrong.

nodes.description: Rebuilding the endpoint without retrieval and with real replicates did not produce a condition component: 0.026 and a clamped zero. This weakens the insensitive-endpoint reading without establishing absence.
Adopt the pandoc to docx route with the Korean manuscript as the single canonical source, and verify every form rule from the docx XML rather than from a PDF conversion.

alternatives: XeLaTeX with kotex and a pinned CJK font
Korean canonical manuscript through pandoc to docx, with form verified from artifact bytes
keep English and attach a translation
nodes.falsifier: If a rule that matters cannot be decided from the docx bytes, the byte-only choice is insufficient and a rendering step must be added.

nodes.description: Generate every figure from the committed specification with the deterministic vector route, record the route per figure in the ledger, and swap the route without touching the specification if a credential or an externally generated image arrives.
nodes.question: How are the nine figures produced with no image-generation credential?
alternatives: wait for a credential
ask the user to generate them externally
render from the same specifications with a deterministic vector tool
nodes.falsifier: If the rendered figures fail the OCR label gate or cannot express a specification, the deterministic route is inadequate for that figure and it must be produced another way.

alternatives: inspect them by eye
check only that files exist
render from the specification and gate on machine-recovered labels
nodes.falsifier: If a figure passes the gate but a reader cannot follow it, machine-recovered labels are the wrong proxy for readability.

nodes.description: Nine figures rendered deterministically and gated on machine-recovered labels, all at a full match; four real defects found by the gate.

Name the set a supervisor-model-anchored calibration set everywhere, never human-anchored, keep judged scoring inadmissible on both grounds, and prepare a supplement of eight items in the same strata so the shortfall can be closed.

reject them because the labeller is not a person
accept them as a model-anchored set, rename every reference, and keep judged scoring inadmissible
nodes.falsifier: If human labels later agree closely with this set on the same items, the model anchor was an adequate substitute and the distinction mattered less than claimed.

nodes.description: Record the exact failure body in the route receipt, mark every figure route as a vector fallback after an image-route failure, and keep the deterministic renders.

retry repeatedly
record the failure and keep the deterministic renders
nodes.falsifier: If credit is added and the generated figures pass the same readability gate, the vector route was a stopgap rather than the better choice.

nodes.description: Add a judge section to the cost ledger with a conservative upper-bound estimate per call group, state the assumed rates and that they are assumptions, carry the cumulative figure in the status header, and stop judge calls if it passes ten dollars.

alternatives: ignore it as small
report call counts only
estimate an upper bound in currency and put a stop rule on it
nodes.falsifier: If provider billing shows spend above the upper bound, the assumed rates were too low and the bound was not conservative.

nodes.description: Twenty-five calibration labels received from a language model outside the judged pipeline, 19 decidable, second-pass agreement re-derived at 24/25 and 18/18; named a model-anchored set and never human-anchored.
Mint a new pinned toolchain revision containing Noto Sans KR under an open font licence, select it by family name so no absolute path enters the manuscript, and keep a single canonical Korean source.

relax the isolation rule to admit a system font
mint a pinned toolchain revision that contains a redistributable Korean font
nodes.falsifier: If the new revision cannot reproduce the existing English build byte for byte, the font addition changed more than the font and the revision must be rebuilt.

nodes.description: The pinned compiler drops Korean silently, renders it with a font, and the isolated build refuses a system font; a pinned toolchain revision carrying an open-licence Korean font is the chosen path.
